being nonchalant is costing you thousands of dollars every day.

being nonchalant is probably the most expensive personality traits you can have.
because while you're trying to look like you don't care, everyone else is quietly getting ahead of you in ways that compound every single year.
the people who win are rarely the most talented in the room, they are simply the ones who care out loud and follow through when it is inconvenient.
so start caring about something this week, and let it show on purpose.
